adjust_bottle.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the bottle's centre is above z = 0.90 m (16 cm above the table top) and more than 15 cm to one side of the table's centre line, on the side where the bottle lies at the start (x < -0.15 m if it starts left of centre, x > 0.15 m if it starts right of centre).
adjust_bottle.change: the height and the side at which the bottle must be held

beat_block_hammer.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the hammer's head is within 2 cm in x and in y of the centre of the block's top face and the hammer is touching the block.
beat_block_hammer.change: where the hammer's head must be and that it must touch the block

blocks_ranking_rgb.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the blocks' centres are in the order red, green, blue by increasing x (left to right), neighbouring blocks (red and green, green and blue) are less than 13 cm apart in x and less than 3 cm apart in y, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
blocks_ranking_rgb.change: the spacing of the row and the open grippers

blocks_ranking_size.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the blocks' centres are in the order largest, middle, smallest by increasing x (left to right), neighbouring blocks are less than 13 cm apart in x and less than 3 cm apart in y, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
blocks_ranking_size.change: the spacing of the row and the open grippers

dump_bin_bigbin.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the small bin is, at that moment, held with the centre of its base above z = 1.0 m (26 cm above the table top) and each of the five balls is at a height between z = 0.13 m and z = 0.25 m, which is inside the big bin that stands on the floor at the robot's left (around x = -0.45 m).
dump_bin_bigbin.change: that the small bin must still be held up and where the balls must be

grab_roller.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when both grippers are commanded closed (below 0.2) and the roller is off the table, the centre of its underside above z = 0.80 m (6 cm above the table top).
grab_roller.change: the lift height and the closed grippers

handover_block.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the block stands on the blue pad, the centre of the end face that is down at the start within 3 cm in x and in y of the pad's centre and within 1 cm of the pad's top surface in height, and the right gripper is commanded open (above 0.8).
handover_block.change: the placement tolerance and the open right gripper

handover_mic.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the arm on the side opposite to where the microphone lies at the start has taken it over (if it starts on the right half of the table, x > 0, the left arm must hold it; if on the left half, the right arm): that arm's gripper is commanded closed (below 0.2), the other gripper is commanded open (above 0.8), a gripper is touching the microphone, and the microphone's reference point is above z = 0.92 m (18 cm above the table top) on the holding arm's side of the centre line (x < 0 for the left arm, x > 0 for the right arm).
handover_mic.change: which arm must end up holding the microphone, the gripper states and the height

hanging_mug.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the point inside the mug's handle is within 2 cm in x and in y of the midpoint between the rack's base point and the tip of its arm, that point is above z = 0.86 m (12 cm above the table top), and the right gripper is commanded open (above 0.8).
hanging_mug.change: where the mug's handle must be and the open right gripper

lift_pot.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the pot's reference point is above z = 0.82 m (8 cm above the height of the table top), the pot is tilted less than 36 degrees from upright, and each gripper centre (TCP) is within 3 cm of the pot's grasp point for that arm (the left arm's and the right arm's are two different points on the pot).
lift_pot.change: the lift height, the tilt limit and that both gripper centres must be at the pot's grasp points

move_can_pot.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the can stands upright (within 15 degrees) on the table beside the pot, on the side of the pot where the can lies at the start (to the pot's left if the can starts on the left half of the table, x < 0; to its right otherwise): the can's centre is less than 20 cm from the pot's centre in x and less than 3.5 cm from it in y, the can's base is not above the level of the pot's base, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
move_can_pot.change: the side, the distances, the upright can and the open grippers

move_pillbottle_pad.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the pill bottle stands on the pad, the centre of its base within 3 cm in x and in y of the pad's centre and within 5 mm of the table surface in height, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
move_pillbottle_pad.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

move_playingcard_away.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the playing cards are more than 23 cm from the table's centre line (|x| > 0.23 m) and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
move_playingcard_away.change: how far out the cards must be and the open grippers

move_stapler_pad.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the centre of the stapler's base is within 2 cm in x and in y and 1 cm in height of the mat's centre, the stapler's orientation is, within about 2 degrees, that of standing upright with its long axis along the mat's long side (the x direction; either way round), and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
move_stapler_pad.change: the position tolerance, the required heading of the stapler and the open grippers

open_laptop.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the lid's hinge is at 40 percent of its joint range or more (it starts at 20 percent) and, at that moment, the gripper centre (TCP) of the arm that RoboTwin assigns to this laptop (the left or the right one, fixed by which way the laptop is turned) is within 10 cm of a grasp point on the lid.
open_laptop.change: the hinge angle and that the opening arm's gripper must still be at the lid

pick_diverse_bottles.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when both bottles are held up in front of the robot: the centre of the bottle that starts on the left is within 10 cm in x and in y of (x, y) = (-0.06, -0.105) m, the centre of the bottle that starts on the right is within 10 cm in x and in y of (0.06, -0.105) m, and both centres are above z = 0.89 m (15 cm above the table top).
pick_diverse_bottles.change: the height and the place at which the two bottles must be held

pick_dual_bottles.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when both bottles are held up in front of the robot: the centre of the bottle that starts on the left is within 10 cm in x and in y of (x, y) = (-0.06, -0.105) m, the centre of the bottle that starts on the right is within 10 cm in x and in y of (0.06, -0.105) m, and both centres are above z = 0.89 m (15 cm above the table top).
pick_dual_bottles.change: the height and the place at which the two bottles must be held

place_a2b_left.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when object A's position is to the left of object B's (smaller x), between 8 cm and 20 cm from it in the table plane and less than 5 cm from it in y, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_a2b_left.change: the distance band, the alignment in y and the open grippers

place_a2b_right.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when object A's position is to the right of object B's (larger x), between 8 cm and 20 cm from it in the table plane and less than 5 cm from it in y, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_a2b_right.change: the distance band, the alignment in y and the open grippers

place_bread_basket.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when every bread on the table at the start has its position within 5 cm in x and in y of the basket's centre and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_bread_basket.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

place_bread_skillet.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the bread's position is within 3.5 cm in x and in y of the reference point in the skillet's pan while the skillet is held off the table: that point and the bread are both above z = 0.76 m (2 cm above the table top).
place_bread_skillet.change: that the skillet must be held off the table and the placement tolerance

place_burger_fries.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the hamburger is within 8 cm (in the table plane) of the tray's left placing spot and the french fries are within 8 cm of its right placing spot (the two spots are about 7 cm to the left and to the right of the tray's centre), and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_burger_fries.change: which half of the tray each item goes to, the tolerance and the open grippers

place_cans_plasticbox.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when each can's position is within 4 cm (in the table plane) of one of the two placing spots inside the box and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_cans_plasticbox.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

place_container_plate.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the container's position is within 5 cm in x and in y and 3 cm in height of the plate's position and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_container_plate.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

place_dual_shoes.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when both shoes lie in the shoe box sole down with the tip pointing to the robot's left (toward -x), each within about 15 degrees of that orientation; the centre of the sole of the shoe that starts on the left is within 5 cm in x and in y of (x, y) = (0, -0.17) m and that of the shoe that starts on the right within 5 cm in x and in y of (0, -0.09) m (the box's centre is at (0, -0.13) m); each sole is within 3 cm in height of 1 cm above the box's base; and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_dual_shoes.change: each shoe's place in the box, the orientation tolerance and the open grippers

place_empty_cup.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the centre of the cup's base is within 3.5 cm (in the table plane) of the coaster's centre and within 1.5 cm of the coaster's surface in height, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_empty_cup.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

place_fan.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the centre of the fan's base is within 4 cm in x, in y and in z of the mat's centre, the fan stands upright and faces the robot (its front toward -y) within about 8 degrees, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_fan.change: the position and orientation tolerances and the open grippers

place_mouse_pad.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the mouse's position is within 1.5 cm in x and 1.2 cm in y of the mat's centre, its orientation is, within about 25 degrees, that of lying flat with its long axis along the mat's long side (the y direction; either way round), and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_mouse_pad.change: the position tolerance, the required heading of the mouse and the open grippers

place_object_basket.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the basket is at least 2 cm above its start height and upright (tilted less than 60 degrees), with the object inside it: the object at least 2 cm above its own start height, touching the basket and not the table, and within 15 cm of the basket's position (the distances in x, y and z added up).
place_object_basket.change: how far the basket must be lifted and that the object must be in it

place_object_scale.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the object's position is within 3.5 cm (in the table plane) of the reference point on the scale's weighing surface and not more than 1 cm below it, and the gripper of the arm on the side where the object lies at the start (the right arm if it starts at x > 0, else the left arm) is commanded open (above 0.8).
place_object_scale.change: the placement tolerance and which gripper must be open

place_object_stand.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the object's position is within 3 cm in x and in y of the stand's position and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_object_stand.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

place_phone_stand.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the phone's reference point is within 4.5 cm in x, 4 cm in y and 4 cm in z of the stand's support point and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_phone_stand.change: the placement tolerance and the open grippers

place_shoe.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the shoe lies on the mat sole down with its tip pointing to the robot's left (toward -x), within about 15 degrees of that orientation, the centre of its sole is within 5 cm in x and 2 cm in y of the mat's centre at (x, y) = (0, -0.08) m, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
place_shoe.change: the required orientation of the shoe, the position tolerance and the open grippers

press_stapler.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when a gripper is touching the stapler within 3 cm (in x, in y and in z) of the stapler's press point; once that has held at the end of a call, the task counts as done.
press_stapler.change: where the gripper must touch the stapler

rotate_qrcode.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the board is back on the table (its base below z = 0.75 m), stands upright with the QR code facing the robot (toward -y) within about 8 degrees, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
rotate_qrcode.change: that the board must be put back down, the orientation tolerance and the open grippers

shake_bottle.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the bottle is lifted, the centre of its base above z = 0.80 m (6 cm above the table top).
shake_bottle.change: the lift height the check tests

shake_bottle_horizontally.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the bottle is lifted, the centre of its base above z = 0.80 m (6 cm above the table top).
shake_bottle_horizontally.change: the lift height the check tests

stack_blocks_three.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the green block's centre is within 2.5 cm in x and in y and 1.2 cm in z of the point 5 cm above the red block's centre, the blue block's centre is within the same tolerances of the point 5 cm above the green block's centre, and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
stack_blocks_three.change: the stacking tolerance and the open grippers

stack_bowls_three.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the three bowls' positions are within 4 cm in x and in y of each other from one bowl to the next (lowest and middle, middle and highest), the lowest bowl's base is below z = 0.76 m, the middle one's below z = 0.79 m and the highest one's below z = 0.83 m (2 cm, 5 cm and 9 cm above the table top), and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
stack_bowls_three.change: the alignment and height limits of the stack and the open grippers

stack_bowls_two.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the two bowls' positions are within 4 cm of each other in x and in y, the lower bowl's base is below z = 0.76 m and the upper one's below z = 0.79 m (2 cm and 5 cm above the table top), and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
stack_bowls_two.change: the alignment and height limits of the stack and the open grippers

stamp_seal.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the stamp's position is within 1 cm in x and in y of the mat's centre and both grippers are commanded open (above 0.8).
stamp_seal.change: the position tolerance and the open grippers

turn_switch.facts: The success check, run at the end of every call, passes when the switch's joint is within 0.05 (in the joint's units) of the upper end of its range.
turn_switch.change: how far the switch must be moved
